units.function: Pure Express error-middleware tests for generic and HttpError 500 responses, a cloud-import disclosure exception and asynchronous responsible-user denial outcome recording.
units.dependencyDirection: Vitest -> error middleware/HttpError -> mocked responsible-user Run-outcome recorder and response diagnostic fields; no real logger, database, tracing/exporter or client is exercised.
units.keyDataModels: HTTP status/error/message/code/details response, actor source and Agent Run identity, original Error diagnostic context and responsible-user denial code.
units.lifecycle: Catch route error -> classify HttpError/generic and special import path -> emit JSON -> attach internal error context for 500 -> optionally record a responsibility denial against the active Run.
units.testAssessment: Focused Vitest passed 4/4. It accurately pins current behavior but intentionally expects raw internal messages in two 500 paths and barely covers the public error schema. Diagnostic logging/redaction and denial-record durability are not tested.
units.designRationale: Hide ordinary unexpected failures, preserve original errors for observability, provide import troubleshooting detail to a trusted cloud caller and project certain responsibility denials onto the active Run.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs a deployment-neutral, localization-safe and security-safe API error contract plus durable responsibility outcomes that never depend on English strings or leak internal details.
units.companyOsFit: REIMPLEMENT with a versioned error envelope: stable code, safe structured params, correlation ID and optional field violations; never expose raw exception text by route/deployment/actor. Send classified causes to access-controlled diagnostics, enforce redaction, and persist responsibility denials synchronously or through a transactional outbox before claiming evidence completeness.
units.responsibilityConflict: Recording one denial code is directionally aligned, but a best-effort asynchronous side call is not a durable responsibility record. Raw error disclosures may reveal company data or infrastructure while providing no accountable disclosure policy.
units.securityFindings: CRITICAL internal error disclosure: cloud import exposes generic Error text and all HttpError 500s expose their message. HIGH unstable/localization-hostile contract: many responses lack code and use English error strings. HIGH diagnostic-redaction gap: attached errors coexist with request body/query context but logging safety is untested. HIGH responsibility durability gap: denial recording is only invocation-tested from synchronous middleware.
